primary_mission: Continuously develop the highest achievable genuinely accurate 24h and 7d crypto BUY / SELL / WAIT signals with positive after-cost expectancy.

priority_formula.safety_reliability_exception: Operational/security work may outrank alpha research only when required to preserve validity, availability, authenticity, or fail-closed evidence collection.

scorecard.evidence_policy: Claims use only independent non-overlapping observations from the declared evidence stage. Historical/OOS and genuine-forward results are reported separately and never pooled to inflate confidence.

current_bottleneck.evidence: Fresh live evidence shows the 24h ACC-002 lane resolves 28/30 histories and supports both predeclared Top-15 and Top-30 liquidity subsets, so 24h is no longer blocked by liquidity coverage. Untouched OOS nevertheless remains closed, which means the current fixed cross-sectional momentum candidates have not established sufficiently stable positive train/validation rank IC and worst-stress after-cost spread across the required subsets. The 7d lane remains history-limited and should receive low-priority rechecks only.
preferred_actions: prioritize data-ready 24h hypotheses that can demonstrate incremental positive after-cost expectancy before untouched OOS
diagnose which fixed train/validation profitability or rank-quality condition rejects the current 24h ACC-002 candidates before proposing a new challenger
prefer materially distinct economic mechanisms such as beta-neutral residual momentum or selective WAIT over blind indicator or parameter permutations
reject quickly when train/validation after-cost value is unstable or nonpositive rather than tuning to rescue a hypothesis
keep 7d insufficient-history work at low-priority recheck-only unless genuine coverage materially changes
keep the 0.80 liquidity coverage requirement and two-subset requirement unchanged
never open untouched OOS merely to search for a profitable configuration

python_research_workers.purpose: Generate bounded chronological research evidence and challengers for 24h/7d signal quality.
python_research_workers.signal_path: research_runner/cross_asset_runner -> sealed evidence -> validation/OOS/robustness -> challenger/forward proof

cross_asset_rank_24h.signal_path: liquidity-safe universe -> chronological rank research -> untouched OOS when gates permit

cross_asset_rank_7d.signal_path: liquidity-safe universe -> chronological rank research -> untouched OOS when gates permit

learning_diagnostics.purpose: Turn genuinely resolved correct/error outcomes into falsifiable research questions.
learning_diagnostics.signal_path: resolved prediction errors -> grouped independent diagnostics -> hypothesis queue

experiment_factory.purpose: Convert diagnostic hypotheses into immutable bounded experiment contracts.
experiment_factory.signal_path: hypothesis -> predeclared validation/cost/falsification contract -> heavy scheduler

heavy_experiment_scheduler.purpose: Allocate scarce heavy compute to highest expected signal-information value without increasing concurrency.
heavy_experiment_scheduler.signal_path: priority formula -> one bounded heavy candidate -> canonical evidence gates

validation_workers.purpose: Protect signal-development claims from leakage, overlap, false discovery, cost illusion, and weak samples.
validation_workers.signal_path: candidate evidence -> independent chronological/OOS/robustness checks -> accept/reject/unresolved

autonomous_cloud_specialist.purpose: Perform bounded reasoning/coding work on the highest-value READY signal-development task.
autonomous_cloud_specialist.signal_path: shared objective/coordination -> isolated candidate PR -> exact-head CI -> manual Lead review

lead_coordination.purpose: Keep all workers aligned to genuine forward signal quality and integrate only verified compatible improvements.
lead_coordination.signal_path: scorecard/bottlenecks -> deterministic task priority -> specialist/worker assignment -> integration

operational_security_workers.purpose: Preserve authenticity and availability of signal-development evidence; they do not claim alpha.
operational_security_workers.signal_path: detect failures/tampering/staleness -> fail closed -> protect research and forward-proof validity
